### The Golden Lampstand
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/golden-lampstand
Passage: Exodus 25:31-40
Points:
- The ornate lampstand with its almond-blossom design evokes the Tree of Life, symbolizing vitality, hope, and fruitful life in God's presence.
- The burning lamps provided necessary light inside the windowless sanctuary, visually reflecting the truth that God is light.
- Being crafted from a talent of pure gold emphasized that the worship of God demands the finest materials and craftsmanship.
- Believers are challenged to honor the Lord today by dedicating their very best in personal worship, finances, and service.
